identity.premise: A floating non-animal identity organized around a central core and an incomplete orbital structure.

visual_contract.topology: Ungrounded central core with structurally separated orbital masses; no conventional quadruped body plan.
silhouette_invariants: The character reads as floating rather than standing on animal-like legs.
The orbit creates meaningful negative space around the central core.
The orbital structure is visibly incomplete or asymmetric rather than a perfect halo.

signature_features.description: An incomplete asymmetric orbital structure whose gaps and offset masses define the identity around the central core.

material_intent: Central core and orbital masses should read as materially related but visually separable.
adaptable_properties: pose/orbit rotation within preserved broken-orbit read

provenance.notes: Derived from the Spirit direction in Character Desirability Experiment v0.1 solely as a DRAFT architecture reference. It is not production canon or a flagship selection.
